app.title: Kinetic
app.subtitle: For Omarchy
app.keys: Ctrl + 1–9 or Ctrl + Tab: pages · Ctrl + ,: settings · Ctrl + R: reload · Esc: close
app.reload.about: Restart the engine, glass, bar and this app
glass.about: Bends and frosts what is behind the bar and windows, and catches the light. Needs a live wallpaper or Omarchy's background.
glass.barOff: The pill is off, so the bar has no glass. Turn the pill on under Bar.
glass.transparent: Window glass shows only through see-through windows.
glass.masterOff: Off: the bar uses Hyprland's blur and windows have no glass
glass.lookAbout: Applies to both the bar and windows.
settings.localChanges: from a copy with changes of its own
settings.different: %1 is not where this install came from. Updating switches to it.
settings.unknown: %1 is available; which commit is installed is not known.
settings.updating: Updating… the bar and this app restart when it is done.
settings.failed: The update failed. Kinetic is as it was before, or half updated: check again, or run install.sh.
settings.updateSure: Install it? The bar and this app restart.
settings.license: Free software under the MIT License.
settings.attributionsAbout: Kinetic includes or follows the work of others. Their full notices are in %1.
attr.layerShell.name: wlr-layer-shell protocol · Drew DeVault
attr.layerShell.what: The Wayland protocol the wallpaper engine places its layer with (a subset of it is included). HPND-style license.
attr.hyprland.name: Hyprland · vaxerski
attr.hyprland.what: The glass plugin follows Hyprland's corner rounding, so glass ends where windows do, and is built against Hyprland. BSD 3-Clause License.
attr.lowbias.name: lowbias32 · Chris Wellons
attr.lowbias.what: The integer hash wallpapers use for particles and seeds, from hash-prospector. Public domain.
attr.artOfCode.name: The Art of Code · Martijn Steinrucken
attr.artOfCode.what: The short hash behind lw_hash, widely shared on Shadertoy.
attr.omarchy.name: Omarchy
attr.omarchy.what: Kinetic's bar is built on your machine from Omarchy's own bar, and Kinetic runs in the Omarchy shell. MIT License.
attr.builtWith.name: Built with
attr.builtWith.what: Hyprland, Quickshell and Qt, Wayland, PipeWire, libglvnd, libpng, libjpeg-turbo and libwebp.
modules.about: Switch modules off or on, or add one from a GitHub link, folder or archive. Kinetic shows what it will install first.

modules.glass.on: Glass under the bar and behind windows.
modules.glass.off: Off: Hyprland blur on the bar, no window glass.
modules.motion.on: Kinetic's animations, pass-through and wallpaper parallax.
